info.title: Filecheck API
info.description: The Filecheck REST API. Submit files as jobs and fetch results, and set up your account: workflows, upload rules, preflight profiles, connectors, optimize presets, delivery destinations, product mappings, storefront settings and webhooks. All requests are authenticated server-side with your secret key (`sk_live_…`).

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Submit files for preflight, fixing, optimization, validation and previews, and read the results.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Presigned credentials to upload large files directly.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Attach jobs to commerce orders.

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: What happens to a customer's files for a product: the intake rule that checks them on upload, the processing streams, proofing, merging and delivery. Products in your store map to a workflow.

tags.name: Rules
tags.description: Upload rules: which files a product accepts (kinds, MIME types, how many), which preflight profile checks each kind, and what happens when a file fails. A workflow's intake points at one rule.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Preflight profiles: the checks run on a file (size, bleed, resolution, colour, fonts…) with their thresholds, severities and automatic fixes. PDF profiles check PDFs (and vector and office files once converted); raster profiles check images.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Connectors wire a product page to the Element: what the shopper chose (size, page count, sides, finishing) adjusts the rule's size checks for that upload, and what FileCheck measured in the file (page count, size, area) can fill the page's own inputs so the store prices from the real file. The cart plugins store the chosen connector per product.

tags.name: Optimize presets
tags.description: Saved optimize settings (compression, downsampling, colour conversion) that optimize steps can use.

tags.name: Destinations
tags.description: Where finished files are delivered: SFTP and FTP hotfolders, S3 buckets, webhooks. Workflows list the destinations they deliver to. Secrets are write-only.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Which workflow each product in your store uses. The storefront Element opens the mapped workflow on the product page.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: How the storefront Element appears on your product pages: where it mounts, the add-to-cart button it guards, display mode and theme.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: HTTP callbacks for job, proof, account and billing events, signed with X-FileCheck-Signature.
